excerpt: The noise level from the building being poorly insulated would be my only gripe.
Overall beautiful property and the management team tries to show up where they can. The noise level from the building being poorly insulated would be my only gripe.
The apartment building and amenities are very well taken care of and very clean. The amenities are the best part!
I do wish the pool would be open until later in the season, and more affordable indoor parking as well as a bike rack, but we love living here!!
Walkable, downtown location. Well maintained property.
We have been living is the summer house since last month. It is truly a wonderful place.
The community as a whole is a wonderful place to come home to.
The apartments itself, the building and amenities are so great, the security in the building and a convenience to have everything on the site is just amazing.
The staff is very friendly and engaging and the community is wonderful.
Jairo and Ben from maintenance are really awesome. I sent a request in the morning for anything and they come by and fix right away.
The apartment is spacious and comfortable, the building is constantly being cleaned, and the amenities are convenient
The hallways, office area and elevators are immaculate and I can only give a positive review of my experience.
Some note occasional elevator outages.
